lines.text: Paul's team had already suffered and been shamefully treated in Corinth, yet they boldly spoke the gospel of God to the Thessalonians.
Paul's team spoke to please God, who examines hearts, and never used flattery or sought praise from anyone.
Paul's team was gentle among the Thessalonians, like a nursing mother caring for her children, and shared the gospel and their own lives.
They worked night and day so as not to burden anyone, and treated each believer as a king treats his children.
The Thessalonians accepted the message as God's word and suffered from their own countrymen, as the churches in Judea had.
